texts.zh:
铝板上雕刻的坐标大体准确。

这是太阳系，而这块铝板显然来自被我们宇航员标记为太阳系-III的那颗行星。
texts.en:
The directions inferred from the inscribed plaque were largely accurate.

This is the system of Sol, with the plaque apparently originating from the planet our astronomers have labeled Sol III.

texts.zh: 我们已经找到了那些可疑破旧金属废料的源头。太阳系是一个以一颗黄矮星为中心的小星系，一个和[Root.Owner.GetName]的辉煌毫不相称的穷乡僻壤。
texts.en: We have found the alleged source of the tacky metal scrap we recovered. The system of Sol is a pinprick in space centered on a pitiful yellow dwarf, a backwater completely eclipsed by the splendor of the [Root.Owner.GetName].

texts.zh: 我们最终到达了太阳系，那里的人在沥尽心血地用极其原始的方式与外界交流。铝板所标记的源头似乎是从恒星往外数第三块岩石，应该是一颗大陆行星。
texts.en: We have finally reached the system of Sol, a destination some being went to great pains to communicate through a very primitive medium. The plaque's point of origin is seemingly the third rock from the sun, which should be a continental planet.

label.zh: 发表声明。然后把铝板丢到他们的恒星里去。
label.en: Make a statement. Jettison the plaque into their sun.

label.zh: 你们向虚空呼唤，我们便来了。
label.en: You shouted into the void, and we came.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现你的帝国的名称。
note.en: In the game, your empire's name appears here.

note.zh: 依伦理三选一，获得影响力并结束事件链；排外者会丢弃“铝制雕版”标本。
note.en: A three-way choice by ethics gives influence and ends the chain; xenophobes discard the Aluminum Plaque specimen.

texts.zh:
碟片上刻录的坐标大体准确。

这是太阳系，而这块碟片显然来自被我们宇航员标记为太阳系-III的那颗行星。
texts.en:
The directions inferred from the audiovisual record were largely accurate.

This is the system of Sol, with the disc apparently originating from the planet our astronomers have labeled Sol III.

texts.zh: 我们找到了那张被我们修复的破旧的光盘的可能的来源。只是这个星系在太空实在是太过于渺小了，以一颗可怜的黄矮星为中心。在壮丽的[Root.Owner.GetName]面前，这只是一个根本不值得一提的蛮荒之地。
texts.en: We have found the alleged source of the tacky disc we recovered. The system of Sol is a pinprick in space centered on a pitiful yellow dwarf, a backwater completely eclipsed by the splendor of the [Root.Owner.GetName].

texts.zh: 我们最终到达了太阳系，一些生物通过很原始的媒介艰难的通讯的地方。这块徽章的来源看起来是太阳的第三颗行星，那是一个大陆行星。
texts.en: We have finally reached the system of Sol, a destination some being went to great pains to communicate through a very primitive medium. The disc's point of origin is seemingly the third rock from the sun, which should be a continental planet.

summary.text:
# 地球大陆 / Terra Firma

- 分类 Category：探索 Exploration

## 如何开始 How it starts

事件链“太阳坐标”由异常 AST_DEBRIS_FIELD_1_CAT（“残骸场”，另一故事 anomaly-ast-debris-field-1-cat）的 anomaly.95“对别人很重要”选项b或 anomaly.105“老式曲调”选项b开启：在“联邦人类”NPC 系统（com_sol）、核毁灭的太阳系（nuked_sol）或早期太空时代人类所在的太阳系中随机选一个为 sol_target，并设置国家标志 sol_search、创建兴趣点。

The event chain "Solar Coordinates" is started by option b of anomaly.95 "Important to Someone Else" or of anomaly.105 "Old-Timey Tunes" from the anomaly AST_DEBRIS_FIELD_1_CAT ("Debris Field", another story, anomaly-ast-debris-field-1-cat): it picks as sol_target the Commonwealth-of-Man NPC system (com_sol), the nuked Sol (nuked_sol) or the Sol of early-space-age humans, and sets country flag sol_search plus a point of interest.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

舰队进入 sol_target 系统（on_entering_system_fleet）→ anomaly.96“地球大陆”（或几乎相同的 anomaly.106）：清除 sol_target/sol_search，事件链计数 found +1；选项按伦理（中立、排外、亲外星）三选一，都给予影响力加成并结束事件链。

A fleet entering the sol_target system (on_entering_system_fleet) → anomaly.96 "Terra Firma" (or the almost identical anomaly.106): clears sol_target / sol_search and adds 1 to the chain counter found; the options (neutral, xenophobe, xenophile) are chosen by ethics, all give an influence bonus and end the chain.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

单一路径；三个选项由伦理决定，互斥。anomaly.96 与 106 的触发条件相同，实际上只会触发其中先被检查的那个。

Single path; the three options are decided by ethics and are mutually exclusive. anomaly.96 and 106 have identical triggers, so in practice only the one checked first fires.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

排外者在 anomaly.96 的选项中丢弃标本“铝制纪念牌”；图片随生物舰船帝国变化。

Xenophobes discard the specimen aluminium_plaque in anomaly.96's option; the picture changes for bio-ship empires.
